THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Chicken Smash Caesar Tacos

This is your first dual-carb system recipe. One base, two tortilla types, two different plates. Adults get keto + Quest crunch. Kids get familiar tacos + chips on the side. No food fights.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME15 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~510 cal | ~52g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Spread chicken THIN and evenly to the edges — thick = raw center, bad texture.

Ingredients

PROTEIN BASE

  • 16 oz (1 lb) 94/6 ground chicken
  • 3 oz Velveeta Original Shreds (mixed into chicken)
  • 1/4 cup taco seasoning (labels vary — keep it in the background)
  • Redmond Real Salt

Option 1

  • 2 Mission flour street tacos (from the shared cook), plain
  • Chips on the side (amount to preference)
  • Salad on the side (optional)

TORTILLAS

  • 8 La Banderita Carb Counter keto street-taco tortillas (adults)
  • 4 Mission flour street-taco tortillas (kids)

ADULT BUILD (per adult)

  • 4 La Banderita Carb Counter keto street tacos (from the shared cook)
  • 1 cup chopped romaine tossed with 1 tbsp homemade high-protein Caesar
  • 1/2 bag Quest protein chips

Allergens: dairy, gluten, fish.

STOP. All tacos are cooked. Plate differently — adults get Caesar + Quest crunch, kids get simple tacos + sides.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.MIX. Combine ground chicken, Velveeta shreds, salt, and taco seasoning. Don't overwork — keep it loose.
  2. 2.SMASH. Divide the mixture evenly across all 12 tortillas and spread it thin to the edges — this is critical.
  3. 3.COOK. Chicken side down on a medium-hot griddle, 4-5 min until browned and the chicken reaches 165°F. Flip and toast the tortilla side 1-2 min.

Adult — Caesar Crunch (Keto)

  1. 4.SALAD. Toss 2 cups romaine with 2 tbsp of the homemade high-protein Caesar (recipe on /cookbook/high-protein-caesar-dressing), split across the two adult plates.
  2. 5.BUILD. Plate 4 keto tacos per adult with the dressed romaine and half a bag of Quest chips.

Kid — Classic Tacos + Sides · Option 1

  1. 4.PLATE. Keep the tacos plain. Chips and salad on the side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Caesar Crunch (Keto): Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Classic Tacos + Sides: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Chicken side down first — always. If you flip too early, it breaks apart.
  • Keep the taco seasoning subtle — this is a Caesar taco, not a taco-taco.

If something fails

Chicken is dry / rubbery: You overcooked it or skipped the cheese. Velveeta shreds mixed into the chicken are what keep 94/6 moist.

Taco falls apart when flipping: You flipped too early. Wait 4-5 min until chicken is fully browned and bound to tortilla.

Tastes like a regular taco, not Caesar: Too much taco seasoning. Keep it to ~1/4 cup across the whole pound. Let the homemade Caesar carry the flavor.

Chicken layer too thick / raw in center: Spread thinner — divide the pound evenly across all 12 tortillas and push it to the edges. Cook chicken-side down until it hits 165°F.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store cooked tacos flat in a container. Dressing and salad separate.

Reheat: Air fryer 350°F 2-3 min to re-crisp. Don't microwave — kills the crunch.

Lasts: 2-3 days. Best fresh.
